name: garmin-mcp
description: Remote MCP server (Cloudflare Workers + OAuth 2.0/DCR) exposing Garmin Connect Personal API data to Gemini and other MCP clients.

scripts.check: node scripts/check-lockfile.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vitest run && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist

GARMIN_PERSONAL_API_KEY.description: Your Garmin Connect **Personal API key**. Create one on Garmin Connect's Personal API Key page ([instructions](https://developer.garmin.com/gc-developer-program/personal/personal-api)); it's shown only once.

MCP_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: The password you'll type to approve AI apps that connect to your server. Use a long random password (at least 12 characters) and keep it in a password manager.

TIMEZONE.description: Leave as `auto` to use the time zone from your Garmin profile, or name one (e.g. `Europe/Berlin`), so "today" means today where you live.
